protocol.profiles: 20 frozen pair/session profiles from the 2026-08-26 causal post-search report
protocol.signal: one decision per fully closed M15 candle; no daily or session entry caps
protocol.execution: historical broker bid/ask M1; pending STOP fill and SL-first intraminute ambiguity
protocol.risk: EUR 85000 start; target 1% per trade; actual risk constrained by 90% margin utilization, slot budget, leverage and 100-unit rounding
protocol.portfolio: one occupied order/position per symbol; cooldown begins after close; slot counts 1-5
protocol.trailing: activation/BE checked at M1, M5 or M15 close; broker-native trailing then approximated continuously with M1 extremes
protocol.pendingInvalidation: disabled to reproduce current live behavior; the current live code does not cancel a pending order when the structural stop side trades first

limitations: This is inspected development evidence, not a fresh holdout; slot/cadence selection is post-hoc and must be forward validated.
Broker tick order inside each M1 candle is unavailable; ambiguous stop/target/trailing paths use a conservative stop-first rule.
Historical margin-factor changes and broker rejections are unavailable; leverage is 30:1 for major USD pairs and 20:1 for crosses.
Financing, swaps and transient broker minimum-distance changes are not modeled.
